subject: Allocation request: DevForum mini-series attendee trial pool
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-23 09:12 -0700
Subject: Allocation request: DevForum mini-series attendee trial pool

Hi team —

DevForum reached back with final attendee estimates for the November mini-series (two live 45-min sessions + on-demand). They requested we provide a small pool of trial credits for attendees to try Redwood with a straightforward onboarding flow. Proposed allocation attached.

Summary of ask:
- 10,000 trial credits total (single-use per email)
- Redemption window: 60 days from issuance
- Tracking: unique code per session, HubSpot campaign tag

Notes and suggested split (see attached promo_allocation_v1.xlsx):
- 6,000 credits for live attendees (immediate redeem)
- 3,000 credits reserved for post-event follow-ups
- 1,000 buffer for partner ops issues / speaker gifts

Requesting: approval for the pool or guidance on a revised number + any operational constraints we should apply (rate limits, RBAC, whitelisting). DevForum is targeting a developer audience likely to rapidly spin up requests; I want to ensure we protect the runtime and our unit economics.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Growth Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-23 11:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Allocation request: DevForum mini-series attendee trial pool

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachment. A couple of clarifying items before I sign off: 

1) Can we tighten the redemption window to 30 days instead of 60? Our analytics show a large portion of conversion happens within the first month and it reduces risk.
2) If we keep 10,000 credits, what's our expected peak TPS if all live attendees redeem within the first 24 hours? Marcus, can you weigh in on capacity/limits and whether we need to gate issuance?
3) Please confirm whether the codes will be single-use per email or single-use per account (we sometimes see multiple signups from the same org).

If capacity looks good I can approve a reduced pool if you prefer — suggested approval: 8,000 credits with the above constraints.

Onward,
Olga
Director, Partnerships Operations

Quick ops note —

We can comfortably support an 8k issuance with these operational constraints (see ops_limits.md attached):
- Redemption window: 30 days (recommended)
- Per-account limit: single-use per verified email; require email verification step on redemption
- Rate limit: throttle to 10 requests/sec per promo-key with burst allowance to 50 for short spikes
- Monitoring: set an alert if token consumption exceeds 15k tokens/min across the promo pool

If you go to 10k, consider a soft rollout — issue 4k first, monitor 48 hours, then release the rest. That will mitigate any early over-consumption.

I can also pre-provision the codes and hand a CSV to marketing; ops will provide a redemption webhook to mark codes as used in our systems.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Approved: DevForum mini-series trial credit allocation (conditional)

Team / DevForum —

Approved with conditions. Summary below for the record and next steps.

Approved allocation: 8,000 trial credits (single-use per verified email)
Conditions & operational controls:
- Redemption window: 30 days from code issuance
- Per-key rate limit: 10 rps with burst to 50 for 2 minutes max
- Monitoring & rollback: Ops to trigger automatic suspension if consumption > 15k tokens/min across all promo keys
- Instrumentation: Marketing to add HubSpot campaign tag and pass redemption metadata to Redwood via the provided webhook
- Distribution: Pre-provisioned CSV of codes to be delivered to DevForum; do not embed codes in public pages

Evelyn / Ben — please update the allocation spreadsheet and send the final CSV to partners@devforum.co. Include the HubSpot campaign id and the redemption webhook payload spec in the same delivery. Marcus, please provision the codes and share the ops playbook so DevForum support can escalate if needed.

For legal/finance: this is a marketing promo expense; treat as non-revenue trial allocation under DF-2026-11-OP1. Ben, if DevForum requests invoicing or a credit memo, loop Legal/Finance.

I've attached the signed allocation agreement to this thread for DevForum and internal records.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-allocation-agreement.pdf
